question: The H.C.F. and the L.C.M. of two numbers are 3 and 276 respectively. If one of the numbers is 69, find the other one.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Product of numbers = **H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**

Other number = (3 × 276) ÷ 69

Other number = 3 × 4 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**H.C.F.** of two numbers = 3

**L.C.M.** of two numbers = 276

**First Number** (n₁) = 69

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers = **H.C.F.** × **L.C.M.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac7998f1d8a5fadb371d20383aee553a9482ce6d7ee82bcaac26060c8d24ef4c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the other number be **x**.

⇒ 69 × **x** = 3 × 276

⇒ **x** = (3 × 276) ÷ 69

⇒ **x** = 828 ÷ 69

⇒ **x** = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are **co-prime** if their **H.C.F.** is 1. For co-prime numbers, **L.C.M.** is always equal to their product.

H.C.F. and L.C.M. Property

The **H.C.F.** of any set of numbers is always a **factor** of their **L.C.M.**

H.C.F. of Fractions

H.C.F. of fractions = (H.C.F. of Numerators) ÷ (L.C.M. of Denominators).</p
